about.title: How we curate
about.lead: Deal Index tracks software discounts from around the world. Here is what we include, how we check it and how the data stays current.

source.title: Every deal keeps its source
source.body: Each deal links to where it came from: the original community list entry or the merchant's public campaign page. Open any deal to see its source and the date it was last checked.

marks.title: Two source marks
marks.body: Cards only carry badges for exceptions. A deal without a badge is merchant verified.
marks.verifiedBody: On the checked date, the campaign was confirmed on the merchant's public page.
marks.communityBody: Taken from a community list and not yet confirmed on the merchant's page. Treat the merchant's page as the final word.

prices.title: How prices are written
prices.body: Prices keep the merchant's original currency, plan, first-period price and renewal terms, with no currency conversion. Lifetime, first-year, yearly and monthly prices are labeled separately. If only a discount is published, the discount is the headline.

time.title: How dates and times work
time.body: Campaigns with a precise time show Beijing time on the Chinese site and UTC on the English site. Date-only campaigns keep the date the source gives, with no time added, and end according to the merchant's calendar day. A deal with no published start is never treated as not yet started.

checkout.title: The checkout price is final
checkout.body: Discounts, taxes and availability can change at any time. Before you buy, rely on the price and terms shown at the merchant's checkout.

pipeline.title: How the data is updated
pipeline.body: An automated pipeline refreshes the data every day. AI drafts the extraction and the translations, and a human reviews every change before it is published.

fetch.title: Fetch
fetch.text: Check merchant pages and community lists for changes every day.

draft.title: Draft
draft.text: AI extracts prices, dates and terms, and drafts translations.

review.title: Review
review.text: A person checks each change. Nothing goes live without approval.

publish.title: Publish
publish.text: The site is updated and price changes are recorded.

origin.title: Where the data comes from
origin.body: The initial data comes from the community list <link>Awesome-Black-Friday-Cyber-Monday</link> on GitHub. We check and extend it entry by entry.

privacy.title: Favorites and privacy
privacy.body: Favorites stay in your browser. They are never uploaded and no account is needed. Clearing your browser data clears them too.

feedback.title: Feedback and corrections
feedback.body: Found a wrong price, date or term, or want to suggest software? Open an issue on <link>GitHub</link>.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may be outdated, or the deal may have been removed.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: Please try again. If the problem persists, check back later.
